name: Bowora

sources.title: Homepage (agent markdown view) — founder network + startup directory with stars, reviews, Weekly Board
Register — Google/Apple/email signup; 'List your startup' links to /dashboard/startups?new=true behind auth
llms.txt — 'listing pricing shown in the flow is free with a Bowora badge or $1 without the badge; Verified offer $5/yr for up to 10 listings and a do-follow link'

conditions: Listing is free only if you display a Bowora badge on your site; otherwise $1
Account required — registration via Google, Apple, or email; submission lives at /dashboard/startups?new=true
requirements: One persistent startup profile per startup; can collect stars and written reviews
Weekly Board scoring: 1 star = 1 point, 1 written review = 3 points
Verified tier ($5/yr, up to 10 startups) includes a do-follow link — free/badge tier's link attribute not confirmed
Revenue verification (for MRR Board / fundraising / open-to-offers signals) via Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, or Polar
preparation: Decision on badge-vs-$1 tradeoff before starting the listing flow
Founder profile info — Bowora is a founder network, profiles attach to founders
Optional: Stripe/LemonSqueezy/Polar connection if you want MRR verification
workflow: Register at https://bowora.com/register (Google, Apple, or email)
Complete the startup profile; choose free-with-badge or $1 path
Solicit stars and written reviews from real users to climb the Weekly Board
Optionally upgrade to Verified ($5/yr) for do-follow + up to 10 listings
watchFor: Badge-or-$1 model — 'free' really means a reciprocal badge
Live boards (MRR, fundraising, acquisition) may be noindex per their own llms.txt — the durable SEO surface is the /startups profile
Rankings are review-driven; don't solicit fake reviews — platform positions on authenticity
llms.txt warns prices/offers change — 'confirm live details in the current product flow'
countsAsLive: A public startup profile exists at bowora.com/startups/<slug> (or equivalent) showing description, product link, stars/reviews
unknowns: Whether the free/badge listing link is dofollow (only Verified explicitly promises do-follow)
